description: This file defines the SchedulerService interface within the OpenMRS project, specifying methods for task scheduling, management, and lifecycle operations.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of a scheduled task given its ID.

methods.name: onStartup
methods.description: Starts all tasks scheduled to run on startup.

methods.name: onShutdown
methods.description: Stops all tasks and cleans up the scheduler instance.

methods.name: shutdownTask
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled task based on the provided TaskDefinition.

methods.name: scheduleTask
methods.description: Schedules a new task based on the provided TaskDefinition.

methods.name: rescheduleTask
methods.description: Stops and reschedules a task based on the provided TaskDefinition.

methods.name: rescheduleAllTasks
methods.description: Reschedules all currently active tasks, useful after classloader changes.

methods.name: getRegisteredTasks
methods.description: Gets list of tasks available for scheduling, typically from the database.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Fetches a task with a specific ID.

methods.name: getTaskByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a task using its UUID, introduced in version 2.4.0.

methods.name: getTaskByName
methods.description: Fetches a task with a specific name.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task identified by its ID.

methods.name: saveTaskDefinition
methods.description: Creates or updates a task definition; saves it to the database.

methods.name: getSystemVariables
methods.description: Returns system variables as a SortedMap.

methods.name: saveToMemento
methods.description: Saves the current state of the scheduler service into an OpenmrsMemento object.

methods.name: restoreFromMemento
methods.description: Restores the scheduler service state from a given OpenmrsMemento object.

methods.name: scheduleIfNotRunning
methods.description: Schedules a task only if it is not already running, introduced in version 1.10.
